document.title: Anti-Defection Reform Bill Legal Provenance Ledger

claims.text: The Tenth Schedule to the Constitution of India governs disqualification on grounds of defection.
claims.subsequent_history_checked: Amended by the 91st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003.
claims.limitations: Paragraph 4 merger exemption permits wholesale defection.

claims.text: The Supreme Court recommended replacing the Speaker with an independent tribunal to adjudicate defection petitions within a binding time frame.

authorities.title: Keisham Meghachandra Singh v. Speaker, Manipur Legislative Assembly

claims.reviewer_action: Verified against Supreme Court official judgment.
